source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: Competition floors must be at least 60 by 36 feet (2,160 square feet); Championship floors at least 66 by 42 feet; floors free of obstructions; exceptions for competitions only by Ballroom Department Committee approval.

requirement: A future NDCA profile must verify floor dimensions.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED.  DanceFlow does not verify or fulfill it; it remains the organizer's responsibility (R-14) unless DanceFlow explicitly implements and verifies it in a future body profile. It must not block eligible Studio/Custom competitions.
interpretation_notes: NDCA: no explicit effective date is printed in the supplied PDF (cover: June 2026 edition); effective_from 2026-06-01 is the first day of the edition month and must be confirmed. Re-read 2026-11-24. BLOCKER for an NDCA profile; the venue size is never checked today.
